project.title: Document Intake Service
project.definition: A service that produces reviewable, source-traceable records from submitted documents.

domains.title: Intake
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for accepting documents and preserving source identity.

domains.title: Review
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for resolving uncertain extraction before publication.

capabilities.title: Document Intake
capabilities.definition: Accept a document while retaining its source provenance.

capabilities.title: Uncertainty Review
capabilities.definition: Route uncertain fields to a human decision before publication.

competencyAnswers.scope: Operations teams creating trustworthy records from inconsistent documents.
competencyAnswers.domains: Intake owns source preservation; Review owns uncertainty resolution.
competencyAnswers.abilities: Document intake and uncertainty review realize the product outcome.
competencyAnswers.evidence: README and vision prose establish intent while source folders establish implementation.
competencyAnswers.impact: Intake provenance must remain available to review and publication.
